subverticals.description: Electrical contractors specializing in data center power infrastructure, including medium-voltage distribution, busway, PDUs, and generator paralleling.
subverticals.thematic_fit_explanation: Directly benefits from data center capex boom. Every new facility requires extensive electrical infrastructure.
subverticals.lender_fit_explanation: Fragmented market with recurring maintenance revenue, high margins, and low capex intensity. Strong DDTL use case for branch expansion and M&A roll-up.
subverticals.demand_profile: Strong secular demand driven by AI/cloud buildout. Multi-year backlog common.
subverticals.cyclicality_profile: Modestly cyclical. Data center demand somewhat insulated from general construction cycles.
subverticals.fragmentation_profile: Highly fragmented. Thousands of local/regional players. A few national firms exist as strategic acquirers.
subverticals.recurring_revenue_profile: 30-50% recurring via maintenance contracts, testing, and commissioning.
subverticals.margin_profile: Gross margins 35-45%, EBITDA margins 12-18% for well-run operators.
subverticals.capital_intensity_profile: Low. Primarily labor-based. Limited fixed asset requirements.
subverticals.concentration_risk_profile: Moderate customer concentration risk (large GCs/owners). Low supplier concentration.
subverticals.ownership_landscape: Mix of founder-owned, family-owned, and PE-backed. Many acquisition targets remain founder-held.
subverticals.ddtl_use_case_fit: Excellent. M&A roll-up, geographic expansion, capacity expansion for large project backlogs.

subverticals.description: Mechanical contractors specializing in precision cooling systems for data centers and mission-critical facilities.
subverticals.thematic_fit_explanation: Cooling is the second-largest cost center in data center construction. AI workloads drive increasing cooling requirements.
subverticals.lender_fit_explanation: Similar lending profile to electrical: fragmented, recurring maintenance, good margins. Slightly more capital-intensive due to equipment.
subverticals.demand_profile: Strong. Liquid cooling adoption creates additional demand on top of traditional HVAC.
subverticals.cyclicality_profile: Modestly cyclical. Mission-critical retrofit work provides baseline demand.
subverticals.fragmentation_profile: Fragmented. National players like Comfort Systems serve as strategic buyer backstop.
subverticals.recurring_revenue_profile: 40-60% recurring via maintenance, monitoring, and service contracts.
subverticals.capital_intensity_profile: Moderate. Some equipment and fleet investment required.
subverticals.concentration_risk_profile: Moderate. Similar dynamics to electrical contractors.
subverticals.ownership_landscape: Mix of founder-owned and PE-backed. Active consolidation in HVAC services.
subverticals.ddtl_use_case_fit: Strong. M&A roll-up, de novo branch, equipment for contracted growth.
example_borrower_archetypes: Regional HVAC contractor with data center specialization
